description: Read a job’s Instructions revision token (job_instructions.revision.get): the durable change signal for cheap polling — the job set’s revision counter and the inherited folder set’s, folded into one comparable revisionToken. Compare it to the last value you saw: a different token means a committed structure or content change (or a folder membership change) of what workers read through the job; it says THAT something changed, never what — read inspect / read_page / history / releases for the content. There is no durable event log or webhook. Requires instructions:read.
name: opentrain_job_instructions_revision
